description: This file implements a class for integrating the SearXNG web search engine via its API, providing methods for request configuration, validation, URL construction, request transformation, and response parsing. It extends a base search configuration class and utilizes external modules for HTTP requests and logging.

classes.name: SearXNGSearchConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for performing web searches through the SearXNG API, providing methods for request validation, URL generation, request transformation, and response parsing.

methods.name: str ui_friendly_name()
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for the search engine, i.e., 'SearXNG'.

methods.name: get_http_method(self)
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method to be used for requests, which is 'GET' in this implementation.

methods.name: Dict validate_environment( self, headers: Dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Validates environment variables and headers, optionally adding an API key if configured.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], optional_params: dict, data: Optional[Union[Dict, List[Dict]]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete search URL with query parameters for the GET request, based on the provided environment, parameters, and data.

methods.name: Dict transform_search_request( self, query: Union[str, List[str]], optional_params: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms a generic search query and parameters into a SearXNG-specific request dictionary, mapping parameters appropriately and constructing query parameters.

methods.name: SearchResponse transform_search_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Parses the raw API response and maps it into the unified SearchResponse format, extracting key fields such as title, URL, snippet, and date.
